facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: loss of containment at CV-3103 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on CV-3103 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on CV-3103 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on CV-3103 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. CV-3103 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during shift handover while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 11 April 2022 an incident occurred on CV-3103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
